title: Japan Ready Reliability & Journey Session Preview
changes: One word, many ways: new vocabulary now flows through see → hear → recognise → read → context → recall → use instead of repeating the same meaning question.

Skill-profile selection: Kaishi tracks meaning, listening, reading, recall, and context strength per word and chooses the activity you actually need — not another easy question on a skill you already know.
Recognition → recall → context → production progression: a single correct answer no longer marks a word as fully known.
Surprise reviews: older vocabulary is woven into missions without labelling it as a review, closer to real retrieval from context.
Delayed within-session reinforcement: the same word is spaced across other words instead of appearing three times in sixty seconds.
Forgotten-word rescue: words that slip from strong to forgotten get a guided rebuild sequence — meaning, audio, recognition, context, recall.
Mistake-driven reinforcement: wrong answers schedule a different skill retest later in the mission, not just the same question again.
Today's Journey dashboard: new vs reviewed vs strengthened vs rescued word counts, plus recall accuracy — eight new words means eight words never started before, not raw activity counts.
